element.description: The element the session belongs to

answers.description: What the student entered; absent until the element first renders

response.description: The parts the student selected, one entry per model with a selection

noOfModel.description: The number of models the student chose; written only when the model's `allowedStudentConfig` is set, and empty until the student enters one

partsPerModel.description: The parts per model the student chose; written only when the model's `allowedStudentConfig` is set, and empty until the student enters one

id.description: Indicates the response id for bar or pie model: the model's 1-based position

value.description: Indicates the selected response sector for model value: the number of parts selected in the model
